title: The Cracked Globe Caper
subtitle: A Story About Miscalculations and Marching Bands
dedication: For all the students who’ve ever broken something and said, 'I’ll fix it later' — that’s when the real trouble begins.
back_cover_blurb: When a simple accident turns into a town-wide crisis, three seniors learn that good intentions don’t always come with instructions. With marching bands, clay globes, and a lot of alphabetizing, this little book shows how one broken glass sphere can change everything — or nothing at all.
moral: Even when things go wrong, a little calm thinking and honest words can make everything right again.
premise_seed: The gang breaks a classroom globe and decides to replace it before anyone notices, instead of just saying sorry.
